seed.deterministic: seed = ns_seed('mmprt'); re-running the same namespace deletes and regenerates identical rows and checksums

row_counts_provenance: Whole-table COUNT(*) per OW_BILLING table as the recon Tier 1 would see them, copied from .migration/fixture_counts.json tables_total (counted 2026-10-07T06:45Z via sqlplus as OW_BILLING inside the container, s1.2-fixture). NOT from .migration/census.json: its tables[*].row_estimate is null for all 20 tables because ALL_TABLES.NUM_ROWS is NULL on this never-analyzed schema (05_decisions.md F25). Totals include the static rows shipped by schema/03_seed_static.sql outside the mmprt namespace: CUSTOMER_MASTER 1 (OW-ADMIN-0001), ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE 4, TENANTS 10, plus every row of the small core tables (CODES, PLANS, INVOICES, INVOICE_LINES, CREDIT_NOTES, RATING_*, DUNNING_ATTEMPTS, NOTIFICATIONS).

planted_hostile_shapes.rule: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_header h WHERE h.invoice_id = l.invoice_id)
planted_hostile_shapes.why_it_bites: INVOICE_LINE.INVOICE_ID has no FK (census trap unenforced_pointer -> INVOICES, and nothing at all to INVOICE_HEADER). An embed of lines under invoice headers drops these 37 rows silently; Tier 1 child-cardinality check (1500 lines vs embedded elements) is what catches it. The mapping must decide where orphans go (overflow collection / quarantine) before the load, not after.

Every *_DT column on CUSTOMER_MASTER / INVOICE_HEADER / INVOICE_LINE / ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE is VARCHAR2(9) text in DD-MON-YY (census trap date_as_string, 5 columns on CUSTOMER_MASTER alone); 41 of the 200 mmprt SIGNUP_DT values are unparseable. A TO_DATE / Date() cast fails or yields null; the mapping needs an explicit invalid-date disposition (keep raw string + null typed field) and the recon canonicalization must compare what was actually written.

The obvious split(',') -> array yields empty strings, whitespace tokens, the literal strings NULL/NONE, a 22-digit token and an un-split 'A;B;C'. Sibling CSV columns: CUSTOMER_MASTER.PROMO_CODES_CSV (0-2 codes from SPRING24/LEGACY/WINBACK/VIP/CONV2011, well formed), CUSTOMER_MASTER.CHILD_ACCT_IDS (not populated by the seeder), INVOICE_LINE.GL_ACCT_CSV (1-3 five-digit GL accounts, well formed). Census trap csv_list on all four.

66 rows for ENTITY_TYPE='CUSTOMER' spread over a random subset of the 200 customers (a customer can hold 0..n rows and the same attr_name more than once); ATTR_TYPE is always 'STR' while the values are booleans/numbers/free text in disguise, and attr_name is drawn independently of the value so PORTAL_THEME may be 'TRUE'. Plus 4 static rows from schema/03_seed_static.sql. The census tags this table eav + polymorphic_pointer; F17 says do not fold it into reference data. An attribute embed must keep {k, v} as strings (no type inference) or the recon field aggregates will not match.

Customers are assigned to 20 power-law 'horror' tenant ids (md5_uuid('mmprt:htenant:<i>'), 18 of them actually drawn at mini scale) that do NOT exist in TENANTS (the 5 mmprt TENANTS rows are a different id series, 'mmprt::tenant-0000'..'0004', used only by SUBSCRIPTIONS/USAGE_EVENTS). The first 20 customers are whales (balances 50k-900k, VIP_YN='Y') and invoice headers are gauss-skewed onto them, so one parent holds a large share of the 1,000 headers. A lookup/reference from customers to TENANTS dangles for every mmprt customer; the census trap unenforced_pointer TENANT_ID -> TENANTS is real data, not a false positive.

not_planted_but_present: Everything else the census lists under traps for these tables is schema-level and applies to every row: yn_flag CHAR(1) columns, *_CD code lookups through CODES, 155-column CUSTOMER_MASTER with repeating groups (ADDR_LINE_1..6, PHONE1..4, EMAIL_1..3, FLAG_01..20, UDF_01..40, UDF_AMT_01..10, UDF_DT_01..10), SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST / CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST history copies (0 rows at mini scale). See .migration/census.json traps and .migration/census_dispositions.json.
